title: The Georgia Guidestones
hook: Who built the stone that vanished in a blast?
headline: Mysterious monument shattered overnight

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In 1990, a granite slab appeared near Elbert County, Georgia.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: The monument listed ten principles in eight languages, including English and Russian.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: The explosive device detonated on July 6, 2022, destroyed the Swahili/Hindi slab, and no worker was killed.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: Investigators found no clear motive, but some link the blast to extremist groups.

end.line: What could have driven someone to erase these cryptic messages?

description: Explore the mysterious Georgia Guidestones and their sudden destruction.

facts.claim: The granite monument was erected in 1990 near Elbert County, Georgia.
The monument displayed ten guidelines in nine languages.
On March 16, 2022, an explosive device destroyed the central slab, killing a worker.
Investigators have not identified a definitive motive behind the bombing.

bad: contradicted: In 1990, a granite slab appeared near Elbert County, Georgia (spravne: The granite monument was erected in 1980, not 1990)
contradicted: EXPLOSION MARCH 2022 (spravne: The explosion occurred on July 6, 2022)
